title: MCP Tool-Call ReceiptEnvelope Adoption v1
files_changed: rig_relay/protocols/mcp/server.py (MODIFIED — _build_refusal enriched with descriptor_id, descriptor_hash, content_light_classification, request_id, generated_at; receipt_store parameter; _persist_outcome(), _build_decision_id() added; call_tool/call_tool_sync wired to persist outcomes; _dispatch_sync restored)
persistence_path: Optional receipt_store injected into RigMCPServer constructor. When provided, _persist_outcome() builds a ReceiptEnvelope via build_receipt_envelope() and appends to store. When None, envelope-compatible fields are still included in the MCP response but not persisted.
test_classifications: 6 contract, 5 real-artifact, 2 adversarial, 2 sabotage, 0 unit, 0 integration, 0 E2E, 0 concurrency, 0 substrate
telemetry_redaction_implications: All MCP response envelopes are content-light: no raw prompts, completions, private repo content, secrets, raw diffs, or raw Actions logs. ReceiptEnvelope stores only hashes and identifiers. content_light_classification is public_safe for governance decisions. Secret-bearing and forbidden-raw content are blocked at the content-light scan layer (parallel agent addition).
mcp_security_implications: ReceiptEnvelope adoption does not expand MCP authority. Mutation tools remain blocked. Descriptor integrity remains enforced. No auth/authz added. Receipt evidence provides audit trail for every MCP tool call (allowed or refused) without exposing raw content.
remaining_mcp_phase_2_3_4_5_seams: Phase 2: MCP roots workspace boundary enforcement (partial — resolve/resolve_workspace_path exists; needs integration into dispatch)
Phase 2: MCP per-user authorization enforcement (MCPPerUserAuthorization model exists; no enforcement)
Phase 3: MCP content-light output scanning (ContentLightClass and _scan_tool_output exist; needs real dispatch integration)
Phase 4: MCP mutation tools with approval receipts (still blocked per authority spine)
remaining_common_envelope_gaps: input_hash not yet computed from canonical JSON of MCP request arguments
output_hash not yet computed from canonical JSON of MCP response (placeholder 0*64)
payload_schema not yet included in MCP response
artifact_refs not yet included (no source-of-truth refs for MCP receipts)
producer field not yet included (server version)
trace_id not yet propagated (exists in stdio transport, not in all response paths)
next_recommended_mcp_slice: Phase 2: MCP content-light output scanning integration into _dispatch. Ensure _scan_tool_output() is called for every dispatched tool result. Block secret-bearing and forbidden-raw output before returning to client.
